lines.line: * Then every menu bar item except separators shows in the accessibility tree with its title and a press action

problems.problem: This establishes that some items are exposed, but cannot detect individual menu items missing entirely from accessibility. Neither documented tool supplies an independent menu inventory.

problems.at: def separator: (titles | last | blank) and .key == "-" and (.enabled == false or .enabled == "disabled")
problems.problem: An untitled, disabled command without a shortcut or press action can be indistinguishable from a separator and escape validation. The documented tools expose no separator identity.

This verifies nonblank exposed titles, not that they match independently known titles. The tools provide no independent title source, so an incorrect but nonblank accessibility title cannot be detected.

summary: No blocking problems found. The check launches palantir, reads menus while it is active, and validates exposed titles and press actions. Remaining gaps concern information the documented tools cannot independently observe.
